title: LGU readiness checklist for community-based mental health
note: A self-check built from the duties in RA 11036 Section 37 and AO 2025-0028. It is a study aid, not an official DOH tool.

items.text: A local mental health council or local health board is tasked with CBMH strategies.
A local ordinance on mental health consistent with national policy exists.
A situational analysis and resource mapping have been done.
A CBMH Action Plan (Annex D) is prepared and integrated into the LIPH and Annual Operation Plan.
Funding for the plan has been identified within the LGU's own budget, since the order states no dedicated budget.
Basic tier services (awareness, red flags, screening, referral) are available at barangay level.
Intermediate tier services (assessment, psychoeducation, medication provision) are available through trained nurses.
Advanced tier management and treatment is available through physicians or by referral.
Referral pathways to higher-level facilities and back to the community are agreed within the Health Care Provider Network.
Recovery support (housing, work, meaningful activity) is linked to social services.
Providers have been trained, including mhGAP training for primary care providers.
Community health workers have been trained and supervised.
Service users, carers and civil society are involved from planning to evaluation, with priority for vulnerable groups.
A multi-sectoral stakeholder network is set up.
Patient data are recorded in the MHIS under medical confidentiality rules.
Quarterly reports are scheduled for April, July, October and January using the Annex F indicators.
A Data Sharing Agreement (Annex H) is signed before any third-party data sharing.

actionPlanSections.label: Situational analysis
actionPlanSections.hint: Community profile, health and mental health status, existing services and resources, stakeholders, policy environment, SWOT.

actionPlanSections.label: Needs assessment
actionPlanSections.hint: Priority needs and gaps found in the situational analysis.

actionPlanSections.label: Program plan
actionPlanSections.hint: SMART goals, scope, resources and timeline.

actionPlanSections.label: Implementation plan
actionPlanSections.hint: Activities, responsibilities, budget and risk management.

actionPlanSections.label: Monitoring plan
actionPlanSections.hint: Link activities to indicators; say how data will be analyzed.

actionPlanSections.label: Evaluation plan
actionPlanSections.hint: How results will be judged against the goals.

actionPlanSections.label: Recommendations and next steps
actionPlanSections.hint: What happens after the first cycle.
